title: Cocktails by the water
excerpt: Our poolside bar menu, from zero-proof coolers to long summer drinks.
bodyMarkdown:
The poolside bar has a short menu built for hot afternoons: citrus, ginger, hibiscus and plenty of ice.

### Favourites

- **Zobo spritz**, hibiscus, ginger and lime
- **Palm sunset**, pineapple, orange and grenadine (alcohol-free)
- **The 007**, a dry martini for the traditionalists

Ask the bartender for a tasting flight.
